subject: Model syndication framework & NDA clarifications
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana.park@openbridge.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: syndication terms for OliveWeights model bundles

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really excited about Redwood's serving model and the routing controls you showed. OliveWeights is interested in a lightweight syndication agreement so we can make a set of quantized model bundles available through Redwood's partner catalog.

Attached is a first-pass Syndication_Terms_v1.pdf outlining:
- allowed redistribution channels (Redwood partner catalog + private deployments)
- attribution and labeling requirements
- embargo windows for new checkpoints
- a proposed rev-share split (60/40 OliveWeights/Publisher)

A few questions up front:
1) Does Redwood require a separate CLA or is the syndication agreement sufficient for distribution of weights?
2) How do you handle auditing and access controls for Dedicated/Private deployments (we need per-customer access logs and retention options)?
3) Any technical constraints on redistributing quantized weights (INT8/4-bit)?

If you can share the right contacts on legal and product, we can move to a redline. Would also be happy to jump on a 30-minute call next week.

Best,
Dana Park
Business Operations, OliveWeights
legal@oliveweights.ai

Attachment: Syndication_Terms_v1.pdf (summary page included)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@openbridge.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: syndication terms for OliveWeights model bundles

Hi Dana — thanks for the note and the doc. Looping in Camila (publisher partnerships) and Sergio (legal lead for model licensing).

Quick answers to your numbered questions: 
1) Syndication agreement can cover distribution, but our legal team typically combines a lightweight license addendum with an NDA if there are non-public checkpoint details. We'll have Sergio confirm required clauses.
2) For Dedicated/Private, we provide per-tenant access logs, audit exports (S3), and configurable retention. We can expose a subset of logs to partners via a secure portal or provide periodic exports depending on the contract.
3) Technically we support INT8 and 4-bit quantized artifacts; we maintain compatibility labels and runtime profiles so customers know expected performance/accuracy tradeoffs. There are sometimes limitations on streaming partial state for certain quantized formats — Camila, Sergio: can you add specifics?

Next steps I propose:
- Sergio to review the attached syndication terms and send redline by EOD Friday (2026-05-22).
- Camila to provide a short product note on quantization/packaging requirements.
- Schedule 30-min alignment call with OliveWeights legal + product next week. 

Dana — are mornings (10–11am PT) or afternoons better for you?

Cheers,
Mina
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Dana Park <dana.park@openbridge.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: syndication terms for OliveWeights model bundles

Dana — quick product note to help with the syndication doc: 

Packaging and distribution notes:
- We ask that publisher bundles include: model card (JSON), size/precision manifest, sample prompts, and a checksum file.
- For quantized artifacts we require a runtime tag (e.g., rwq-int8-v2) so our kernel selector can route appropriately.
- Embargo handling: we can gate catalog visibility by date and/or partner tier; if you want phased exposure (e.g., 2-week partner-only window) we can implement that as a catalog policy.
- For private/Dedicated customers that want weights stored on-prem, we support a signed token workflow and an expirable download link; we do not permit sharing of underlying S3 URIs.

Operational SLAs and auditability: 
- Access logs: event-level logs (who, what, when) are retained 180 days by default; enterprise customers can request longer retention.
- Revocation: we can revoke access at customer or bundle level and rotate signed tokens.

Happy to put this in a short appendix for your legal team.

—Camila
Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Dana Park <dana.park@openbridge.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-26 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: syndication terms for OliveWeights model bundles

Thanks — this is helpful. Attached is a redline of the NDA focusing on embargo and redistribution clauses (OLIVE_NDA_redline.docx). A few clarifications from our side after reviewing Camila's notes: 
- We are ok with catalog gating and phased exposure.
- For audits we need the option to receive a quarterly CSV export of per-customer access events for bundles we publish.
- Redistribution: we are comfortable allowing distribution to Dedicated and Private deployments under the condition that Redwood does not sublicence beyond the customer and that OliveWeights retains approval over any white-label re-distributions.

We prefer the rev-share as a revenue reporting schedule (monthly) with a 30-day payment term.

Call availability: 2026-05-31 10:00am PT or 2026-06-01 11:00am PT.

Dana

Attachment: OLIVE_NDA_redline.docx

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@openbridge.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: syndication terms for OliveWeights model bundles

Dana — thanks for the redline and the clarifications. Summary and agreed next steps: 

Summary of points we aligned on:
- Catalog gating: Redwood will support partner-only and phased exposure windows; Camila will add the embargo policy language to the syndication appendix.
- Access logs: Redwood will provide a quarterly CSV export of per-customer access events for published bundles; retention/bulk export details to be captured in SOW.
- Redistribution limits: Redwood will restrict sublicensing; OliveWeights retains approval on any downstream white-label redistribution. Telecom/partner re-distribution requires prior written consent.
- Revenue reporting: monthly reporting with 30-day payment term — finance will map to a simple revenue share flow.

Next actions:
1) Sergio to finalize legal redline on OLIVE_NDA_redline.docx and send final via DocuSign by 2026-06-03.
2) Camila to produce the syndication appendix (quantization labels + packaging checklist) and attach to the master syndication agreement by 2026-06-02.
3) Ops/engineering (cc'ed separately) will draft the CSV export schema; Mina to introduce Ops lead once legal sign-off is in place.
4) Schedule a 30-minute sync on 2026-05-31 10:00am PT — Dana confirmed availability. Meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321

If that all looks right I'll have Sergio start the DocuSign flow.

Best,
Mina
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
